dialogues.speaker: Kotimy
dialogues.text: Probably. He is a vet, after all, and there're always plenty of patients at his clinic.

dialogues.speaker: Kotimy
dialogues.text: But he spends most of the time out on calls with patients.

dialogues.speaker: Kotimy
dialogues.text: If the Saurian he took home to care for isn't suffering from a minor sickness, like a cold, then there's probably something pretty seriously wrong with it.

dialogues.speaker: Kotimy
dialogues.text: Heh, I wish I could learn how to treat Saurians too.

dialogues.speaker: Kotimy
dialogues.text: If I could help a Qucusaurus someday, perhaps it'd let me ride it...
